left_defects.source: welchen mit voll sauffen dienet ist
left_defects.translation: who have no use for heavy drinking

why: Both render the crossing clause (gencket ... / hin) the same way; only difference is an unrelated mistranslation in para 165 on the left.
Both carry the Ca-/Camerario break cleanly; right drops pro refectione in the first sentence after the break.

right_defects.source: multum / arbitror illa ad nros ciues ptine ... Vale

why: Right drops the sentence completing multum and the whole paragraph after the break, and inverts non puto dubitandum.

right_defects.source: Plurimum tamen gaudeo ... Vale (rest of the letter on page 2)
right_defects.translation: (skipped; page 2 jumps to the next letter)

why: Left leaves habuissem implicit but renders page 2; right completes the sentence then omits the rest of the letter.

right_defects.source: ris testimonium non agnoscas ... dignatus es esse redemptio

why: Both handle the clean eternaliter/Oramus break; right omits the opening sentences of page 1.

right_defects.source: vnicuiqz qd suum erat iuste non / dedi
right_defects.translation: I did not justly give to each one what was his. / I gave.

right_defects.source: sapientia, intellectus, consilium, scientia, pietas, timor dei

why: Right renders dedi twice across the break and leaves the gifts untranslated; left splits the sentence correctly.

left_defects.source: se ad unionem hypostaticam, / vel omnipotentiam Dei recipit
left_defects.translation: turns himself toward the hypostatic union. / or receives the omnipotence of God

right_defects.translation: or receives the omnipotence of God

why: Both mistranslate recipit the same way; right keeps the sentence open with a comma, left closes it with a period.
Both render fides unicum est os / et instrumentum correctly with no defects at the break.
Both carry gencket ... / hin across the break equivalently; differences are stylistic.

left_defects.source: aliquid / ad me scribas. Putabo enim ... medelam invenisse. Vale.

why: Left drops the whole closing sentence of the letter after the break; right keeps it but mistranslates scribas.
Clean break for both; left has several meaning errors near it that right avoids.

right_defects.source: tam vigili Episcoporum / constantia, quam severa Regis jussione
right_defects.translation: such a vigilant Bishop- rum / constancy of others, who were urged by the stern command

why: Right breaks the crossing word Episcopo-rum and garbles the sentence; left joins it correctly.
Clean break for both; right drops precibus in the first lines after it.

right_defects.translation: when he could obtain nothing / could be obtained

why: Right renders the crossing nihil impetrare twice; left once.

left_defects.source: Dei, in quo ... an ergo non sunt de Ecclesia?

why: Left skips the continuation of the crossing title and the Trinity/Church paragraph; right renders it.
Both handle the Anony-/Anonymus catchword and the following eulogy without defects at the break.

left_defects.source: vel omnipotentiam Dei recipit ... definivit concilium Chalcedonense

right_defects.translation: or receives the omnipotence of God

why: Left omits the whole first paragraph of page 2 that completes the crossing sentence.

left_defects.source: Tredecimus / principalis continet duos et ambo papae reservantur

why: Left drops the completion of the thirteenth-case heading; right renders it.
Left inserts a bridging label and misrenders nobis; right joins the sentence cleanly.

left_defects.source: hora tremenda mortis mee non deneges ... Amen.

why: Both handle the clean break; left omits the opening prayer ending of page 1, a larger loss than right mistranslation.

right_defects.source: nec per me indignum ... dignatus es esse redemptio

why: Clean break for both; right omits the opening sentences of page 1.
Both drop the continuation of the crossing sentence and the rest of the letter.

left_defects.translation: patrons of our / to elect as Patron of the Chapter
